newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-SYKORA FASTEST IN FIRST RUN OF MEN'S CUP SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-SYKORA FASTEST IN FIRST RUN OF MEN'S CUP SLALOM.

text.p: Thomas Sykora led an Austrian domination of the first run of the men's World Cup slalom at Park City Sunday.
Sykora, third best in the discipline last season, had a time of 51.49 seconds, just ahead of teammate Thomas Stangassinger, clocked in 51.82.
Austrians also stood third and fourth, with Christian Mayer at 52.20 and Michael Tritscher at 52.36. Ole Christian Furuseth of Norway held fifth at 52.50.

Sebastien Amiez of France, last season's slalom champ, skied off corse, as did defending overall champion Lasse Kjus of Norway. Alberto Tomba of Italy, the dominant slalom racer of the last decade, is recovering from an injury and did not start.
